messages:
mei: FYI overnight microbench bringing up atlas13b int8 variants against GTN prompt suite. interesting signal: int8 gives great cost wins but a repeatable 2-4% drop on iterative QA chains (few-shot) driven by numeric hallucination. we should decide on routing + holdback.

raj: can you share the numbers and failing split?

mei: summary from 2k slice (mix of QA, summarization, few-shot examples):
- cost per 1M tokens: fp16 baseline $125 -> int8 $58
- median throughput: 2200 -> 5100 tps
- p95 short chat: 340ms -> 310ms
- p95 long (3k tokens): 1.4s -> 1.85s (regression)
- iterative QA chain pass-rate: 81% -> 77% (-4pt)
- numeric hallucination incidents: 0.8% -> 3.2% (int8)

mei: correlation seems to be with many numeric tokens and long context. traces show int8 quant GEMM path switching at >1280 seq. kernel trace: `quant_path=gemm_int8_v3 seq=2048 host=atlas-13b-node-9 mem_kv=1.3GB`

raj: product exposure estimate?

mei: if we route 70% int8, 20% int6, 10% fp16 -> blended cost ~ $44 per 1M tokens (~65% savings). Product hit estimate: ~0.025% absolute impact on downstream success under fallback.

zach-reliability: deploy-bot: canary started 1755020025 - hooking metrics. noticed a transient error spike 1755020048 correlated to a bad kernel build, rolled back kernel on that host.

deploy-bot: canary roll started: atlas13b-int8 -> 10% traffic. canary_id=cnr-17550 status=started

ana-prod: seeing early user-visible errors in a small customer sandbox 1755020065, flagged to tracing.

mei: action items:
- mei: audit and canonical examples for the iterative QA failures (today)
- raj: put routing rule as seq-length + numeric-intent hybrid; add per-customer opt-out (EOD)
- zach-reliability: beef up p99/p999 kernel alarms + eviction runbook (tomorrow)
- ana-prod: coordinate with affected customer and run manual check for 24h (today)

raj: proposed routing rule:
```
route_policy:
  if detect_numeric_intent == true and request.tokens > 512: model_variant = atlas13b-fp16
  elif request.tokens <= 512: atlas13b-int8
  elif request.tokens <= 1500: atlas13b-int6
  else: atlas13b-fp16
  canary: 10% traffic
  fallback: session-level immediate fallback to fp16 on repeated failures
```

mei: recommendation: proceed with canary but keep it intent-aware and conservative for numeric-heavy flows. do not global-ship until AB test validates.

zach-reliability: acknowledged  setting eviction thresholds.

raj: i'll add AB experiment tracking and a small cost vs quality dashboard for leadership.

mei: thanks all. will post audit when ready. :wave:
